basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 42.' and it opens 'Vers. 42. Nuntiata sunt haec Rebeccae. Quis nuntiavit, cum ille in corde suo dixit?'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 42. Nuntiata sunt haec Rebeccae. Quis nuntiavit, cum ille in corde suo dixit? Utique per spiritum prophetiae hoc cognovit, per quem etiam illum majori fratri praeponendum didicerat.
